digest.component_or_area: Plan review gate R1 validation and counterfactual measurement
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, driver seams, pure metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main because the live batch replay was deferred.

The ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50×3 candidate and 50×3 current runs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in d8a5/change #798 which accumulates the same verdict-perturbation signal from production at zero marginal LLM cost.

The pure metrics library e3_metrics.py must correctly implement criterion_deltas, build_matrix, tkey, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval with two-level-median pairing and null-floor, and fp_control_valid boundary validation, verified by golden tests against synthetic fixtures.

Baseline history mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 required (impact_model_version bump stranded the history), eliminating the primary justification for a one-shot replay.

The recall-stripped clone driver (copy store, delete *-REVIEW_RESULT.json, run replay, verify manifest) and material-fingerprint drift guard must prevent contamination from prior findings and LLM nondeterminism.
The deterministic sample satisfies the cleanly-closed filter (post_claim_edit_class=='none', reopen_count==0, force_close==false) with stratified reproducible draw using random.Random(1729).
